_doc: Proposed MSIP state-dimension matrix (UNDER VERIFICATION — not implemented).

dimensions.name: structure_state
dimensions.semantic: Swing/structure regime: range vs break vs sweep presence
dimensions.config_semantics: thresholds for structure significance if any — config-owned
dimensions.notes: Must respect FC1-A causal swing publication; do not use historical LEAKING labels from fc05 graph as current truth

dimensions.name: liquidity_state
dimensions.notes: FM-025 has UNRESOLVED provenance debt (M6R); FM-026 independently discharged (M7V)

dimensions.name: volatility_state
dimensions.semantic: Canonical volatility_regime int8 tercile of absolute ATR14
dimensions.config_semantics: window/edges currently structural in pipeline; externalization is design decision
dimensions.notes: Consumer debt: s05_grid string TRENDING vs int8

dimensions.name: session_state
dimensions.config_semantics: hour boundaries currently pipeline-hardcoded; externalization is design decision
proposed_consumers: CRT allowed_sessions only via explicit adapter
dimensions.notes: Encoding debts vs SESSION_MAP/dashboard/CRT strings — must not silently unify

dimensions.name: trend_state
dimensions.semantic: Canonical trend_strength nested rolling + optional trend_bias sign
dimensions.notes: NAME COLLISION: dual_engine local trend_strength = abs(ema_spread) — different quantity

dimensions.name: crt_phase
dimensions.config_semantics: owned by crt_engine / active_models state_contracts — MSIP MUST NOT fork
dimensions.notes: OQ-002 unresolved; if included, MSIP is a reader of CRT, not a second SM

dimensions.name: setup_quality
dimensions.semantic: Optional composite of body_ratio / retest_depth / disp metrics at event bars
dimensions.notes: FM-021 is gated composition; FM-027 is CRT-cache identity — do not collapse names
